# Cameron S Humphries

> Independent software by Cameron S Humphries. Cymatic, a cymatics and music visualiser, and While Ago, an offline last-done tracker, are on the Microsoft Store for AUD $1.50. CymaVolt, Cloud Shatter, Catchify, Ambry, and Evercake are in development and are not for sale.

Each app has its own page on this site. Cymatic and While Ago have no account, no ads, and no analytics, and their data stays on the PC. The apps in development are described on their own pages, including what is not available yet.

- [Home](https://cameronhum.github.io/): List of apps by Cameron S Humphries
- [Sitemap](https://cameronhum.github.io/sitemap.xml): Every public page on this site

## Cymatic

Cymatic is an interactive Windows cymatics and music visualiser that turns PC audio into water patterns. PC sound or a built-in tone drives a dish of water. A steady pitch locks the dish into rings, petals, and grids. Silence lets the water settle. Unlike spectrum-bar visualisers, it shows sound as a customisable dish of water, with full screen, orbit, and zoom.

Controls include drive, settle, wave speed, stroke, pitch follow, loudness follow, overtone, amplitude, crests, light, and ambient. Colours are Water, Ink, Gold, Iridescent, Galaxy, Aurora, Ember, and Blood. Surface is normal, low poly, wireframe, or dots. Perimeter is glass, a ring, a fade, or none.

PC audio is read on that computer while the window is open. It is not recorded, saved, or transmitted. No microphone, account, or subscription is needed. Cymatic runs on 64-bit Windows 10 version 2004 (build 19041) or later, including Windows 11. It is a one-time purchase of AUD $1.50 on the Microsoft Store, and Microsoft processes the payment.

- [Cymatic app page](https://cameronhum.github.io/apps/cymatic/): Features, screenshots, FAQ, pricing, and system requirements
- [Download Cymatic on the Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9n09bgpd2857): Official Store listing, one-time purchase of AUD $1.50
- [Cymatic privacy policy](https://cameronhum.github.io/apps/cymatic/privacy/): What the app does with PC audio and settings

## While Ago

While Ago is a Windows last-done and activity tracker. It tracks when you last did things: each habit or routine is a card on a visual workspace, and the card grows as more time passes. Switch between canvas, list, and chart views, keep separate named workspaces, search, archive, and use light or dark mode.

A rhythm can be daily, every few days, weekly, monthly, custom, or learned from gaps already logged. There is no account and no server. Times, notes, workspaces, card positions, and settings stay in local storage on the PC, under the local app data folder for com.whileago.app, and are not uploaded. It runs on Windows 10 and Windows 11 and is a one-time purchase of AUD $1.50 on the Microsoft Store.

- [While Ago app page](https://cameronhum.github.io/apps/while-ago/): Features, screenshots, FAQ, and system requirements
- [Get While Ago on the Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9P3HGRVDRNG0): Official Store listing, one-time purchase of AUD $1.50
- [While Ago privacy policy](https://cameronhum.github.io/apps/while-ago/privacy/): How times and settings stay on the PC
- [While Ago support](https://cameronhum.github.io/apps/while-ago/support.html): Report a bug or ask a question
- [Donate to While Ago](https://cameronhum.github.io/apps/while-ago/donate.html): Optional support for the developer

## CymaVolt

CymaVolt is a bench for guitar-pedal circuits. Place resistors, capacitors, diodes, and potentiometers, wire them to an input, an output, and ground, and hear the circuit while the values change. Play and Bypass sit next to waveforms and a frequency view. The source can be a note, an instrument, a device, or a file. Designs stay in the browser as a .pmk file, a wired section can be saved as a block, and Export packages the pedal as a VST3.

There is no account. Circuits are not uploaded. CymaVolt is not on the Microsoft Store and is not for sale yet.

- [CymaVolt app page](https://cameronhum.github.io/apps/cymavolt/): Features, FAQ, and how a design is stored
- [CymaVolt privacy policy](https://cameronhum.github.io/apps/cymavolt/privacy/): Designs stay in the browser

## Cloud Shatter

Cloud Shatter is an arcade dogfight for Windows. A match is 1v1, 2v2, 4v4, or a free-for-all of 16. The aircraft has a gun, missiles, a heat missile, bombs, and flares. Hits chew the sprite. The hangar fits the engine, wing, plate, paint, attack, and support. The shop sells chests and exchanges gold and gems. Challenges pay gold, gems, and chests.

There is no account. Gold, gems, and the fitted aircraft stay on the PC. Cloud Shatter is not on the Microsoft Store and is not for sale. Gold and gems are inside the game.

- [Cloud Shatter app page](https://cameronhum.github.io/apps/cloud-shatter/): Features, screenshots, FAQ, and where the hangar is saved
- [Cloud Shatter privacy policy](https://cameronhum.github.io/apps/cloud-shatter/privacy/): The hangar stays on the PC

## Catchify

Catchify is a Spotify catch-up. Pick playlists, including liked songs. It lists newer tracks that are not already in those playlists, since the last added release for each artist or inside a time window. The inbox groups by artist, playlist, or album. Select tracks and add them to a new playlist or one you already have. A scan does not write a playlist.

Catchify has no account of its own and no server. You log in with Spotify, and the tokens stay in the browser. It is not on the Microsoft Store and is not for sale. It runs in the browser, which can install it on Windows, Android, or iPhone.

- [Catchify app page](https://cameronhum.github.io/apps/catchify/): Features, FAQ, and how Spotify login is stored
- [Catchify privacy policy](https://cameronhum.github.io/apps/catchify/privacy/): Tokens stay in the browser, and there is no Catchify server

## Ambry

Ambry is a meals, pantry, and shopping list. Tick the meals you want to cook. Ambry checks the ingredients against food already in the house, orders what you can cook next, and lists what you still need to buy. Have and Get hold the cupboard and the shopping. Each food can have a note, a quantity, and an expiry.

With no sign-in, the list stays in the browser. Sign in with email or Google to share one household with an invite code. The shared copy is stored with Google Firebase. Ambry is not on the Microsoft Store and is not for sale.

- [Ambry app page](https://cameronhum.github.io/apps/ambry/): Features, screenshots, FAQ, and how the list is stored
- [Ambry privacy policy](https://cameronhum.github.io/apps/ambry/privacy/): What stays in the browser, and what a shared household stores

## Evercake

Evercake is a birthday calendar for Windows and Android. Home shows who is next, and birthday days fill the calendar. A person can hold a photo, a gift idea, a party note, likes, facts, and a reminder. A 29 February birthday is kept on 28 February in other years. Looks include Soft Sky, Midnight Party, Garden, and Clean Light.

There is no account. People, photos, notes, and reminders stay on the device. Evercake is not on the Microsoft Store or Google Play yet, and it is not for sale.

- [Evercake app page](https://cameronhum.github.io/apps/evercake/): Features, FAQ, and system notes
- [Evercake privacy policy](https://cameronhum.github.io/apps/evercake/privacy/): People and photos stay on the device
